name: django-builder
author: Mark McArdle
comment:overrides: Bun supports only flat, top-level overrides. The Yarn config additionally carried ~32 selective per-parent pins (e.g. **/express/path-to-regexp) which Bun cannot express. They were security/version floors and were dropped during the Bun migration after verifying Bun's fresh resolution already meets or exceeds every one of those floors (minimatch >=3.1.4/5.1.8/6.2.2/9.0.9, ajv >=6.14.4/8.20.0, path-to-regexp express->0.1.13 & router->8.4.2, etc.). bun.lock freezes these. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-04-bun-migration-design.md.

scripts.build: bun run build_io && bun run build_v4 && bun run build_v5
scripts.build_development: bun run build_io_development && bun run build_v4_development && bun run build_v5_development
scripts.build_staging: bun run build_io_staging && bun run build_v4_staging && bun run build_v5_staging
scripts.build_production: bun run build_io_production && bun run build_v4_production && bun run build_v5_production
scripts.lint: bun run lint_core && bun run lint_io && bun run lint_v4 && bun run lint_v5
scripts.lint_fix: bun run lint_fix_core && bun run lint_fix_io && bun run lint_fix_v4
scripts.test: bun run test_smoke && bun run test_core && bun run test_v4 && bun run test_io && bun run test_v5
